study type: Case-control study, in vitro, in vivo animal study
cohort: The human cohort consisted of pregnant women with normal glucose tolerance (n=20) and gestational diabetes mellitus (n=36).
finding: miR-515-5p, specifically encapsulated within extracellular vesicles from omental adipose tissue in gestational diabetes mellitus, regulates placental nutrient uptake, glucose homeostasis, and fetal growth.
